text: Continuous Integration (CI) is a practice where developers regularly add their code to a shared repository. Each time they do this, automated builds start automatically. These builds compile the code and run tests to check that everything works correctly. The main goal is catching issues early, before they become bigger problems. CI pipelines make this process smooth and reliable. A pipeline usually includes steps like building, testing, and reporting results. If a test fails, the team knows immediately and can fix the problem quickly. This saves time and reduces stress. In short, CI helps teams work faster and produce better software.
